proposals.actual_behavior: LookupResult::BlockDevice only has offset field, no size. The size is stored internally in the entry but not exposed in the lookup result enum variant.
proposals.proposed_change: Either (A) add size field to LookupResult::BlockDevice to match spec, or (B) backfill spec to document offset-only return since callers already know size from their initial staging request.
proposals.rationale: Interface design decision — adding size changes the trait signature and all pattern matches on LookupResult. Omitting it means callers must track size separately.

proposals.actual_behavior: Component is named DispatchMapComponent (no V0 suffix)
proposals.proposed_change: Update all spec/doc references from DispatchMapComponentV0 to DispatchMapComponent
proposals.rationale: The component was renamed to drop the V0 suffix; specs should reflect current naming.

proposals.spec_text: MemoryTier with pointer: u64, size: usize
proposals.actual_behavior: MemoryTier uses pointer: *mut u8, size: u32. create_memory_tier_entry takes (*mut u8, u32).
proposals.proposed_change: Update spec FR-018 and Key Entities to use pointer: *mut u8, size: u32 matching the implementation (more idiomatic Rust types — raw pointer instead of integer, u32 for block count consistency)
proposals.rationale: *mut u8 is the idiomatic Rust pointer type for raw memory; u32 for size is consistent with size_blocks in BlockDevice variant and DispatchEntry.
